primary_source_context.review_scope: Saved pinned acoustic operators, checkpoint wrappers, PyRevolve driver/storage, Model, AcquisitionGeometry, PointSource/Receiver, TimeAxis, initializer and padding source text; no remote code executed.

source_findings: No material source-level mathematical or checkpoint-wiring blocker found for this narrowly specified serial OT2, float64, fs=False engineering pilot.

Explicit native time_m=1,time_M=nt-2 and prepared offset checks define the same chosen discrete interval in full-save, rolling finite differences and both checkpoint wrappers. Scheduler half-open [a,b) maps to inclusive [a+1,b]. Final source requires exact once-only initial forward and reverse native-index coverage.

One retained explicit source and fixed receiver dual are hashed; forward scratch and reverse rec=dual bindings are separate. Fresh u/v/grad allocations are explicitly zeroed, including allocated temporal planes and halos. Forward replay does not reset accumulated adjoint state or gradient.

The objective is the unweighted fixed-dual functional L(m)=sum(r*F(m)), so its intended derivative is J(m)^T r. Finite differences perturb physical m, convert vp=1/sqrt(m), and hold dt, source, receiver geometry, dual, damping and native interval fixed. There is no hidden observed-data solve or FWI reconstruction claim.

Pinned Model.m equals 1/(vp*vp); ndarray vp is extended by replicated edges. Actual padded vp is checked against edge padding. Physical-m pullback sums padded gradient faces/corners with E^T rather than cropping; no velocity-coordinate chain factor or quadrature factor is inserted.

Checkpoint.size is treated as element count, nbytes equals size*dtype.itemsize, exactly two allocated temporal planes are required, and actual NumpyStorage shape/dtype/bytes must equal explicit K capacity. Standard uncompressed storage is delegated unchanged; all copy attempts and actual pointer bytes are recorded.
Warm shared JIT-cache effects are disclosed. Generated C and available compiler/library/timer metadata are observational; no cache-hit, fair-speed or matched-cost superiority inference is made.
Final diagnostic delta also scales ru_maxrss as Linux KiB versus Darwin bytes. Linux is the only admitted numerical runtime; Darwin support here concerns manufactured accounting controls.
remaining_execution_gates: Separate root review, frozen criteria and exact source-bound root GO; this review grants no installation or execution authority.

Admit the exact Linux/Python/package versions and installed source hashes in a separately reviewed runtime. Source review does not establish successful dependency installation or backend compatibility.

Actual native execution must establish parameter alias binding, source/dual separation, circular-state extraction/restoration, scheduler behavior, generated time loops, exact K allocation and no saved-history allocation in checkpoint children.

Actual whole-record, padded-gradient, physical-gradient and all registered finite-difference comparisons must satisfy the frozen finite/nontriviality criteria. Source consistency and manufactured accounting controls are not numerical derivative agreement.

A separately reviewed caller must provide fresh serial processes, actual wait exit/signal observations, complete launch-to-return timing, external logs and resource review. Worker intent-to-return fields and comparison receipts alone do not prove actual terminal success.
Preserve every failure/interrupt prefix and registered FD step. No retry, fallback, larger K, changed geometry/time/source or outcome-tuned tolerance is authorized.
